title: Roadmap
intro: One ranking of every project, best first, on a timeline: a row's bar is the span its milestones cover, the shaded band behind it the target window, and flags mark what drifts or is out of rank order. Everyone can read it; administrators and roadmap editors change the ranking.
introEdit: One ranking of every project, best first, on a timeline: a row's bar is the span its milestones cover, the shaded band behind it the target window, and flags mark what drifts or is out of rank order. Drag a row by its handle or use its menu to change the ranking; every change is saved at once. Dropping a row below the Unranked line, or Unrank, takes it out of the ranking; Rank adds an unranked project at the end.
emptyHint: Projects are created on the Plan page and appear here to be ranked.
noMatchHint: Change or clear the filters to see more projects.

rank.sentence: Rank {{rank}}, was rank {{was}} in the baseline
rank.sentenceFromUnranked: Rank {{rank}}, was unranked in the baseline
rank.sentenceToUnranked: Unranked, was rank {{was}} in the baseline

window.title: Target window of {{name}}
window.hint: Both dates are inclusive. Clear removes the target window. You can also drag the shaded band, or draw one across an empty row.
window.forbidden: Only an administrator, an owner above the project or a roadmap editor can change the target window
window.invalid: These dates cannot be saved: the end must not be before the start
window.gone: This project is no longer in the plan — it was removed in the meantime.

flags.title: Flags
flags.intro: What the icons in the Flags column mean, one line per flag: a project running past its target window or starting or ending off it, a project ranked below another that starts earlier, and where Jira's dates or items differ from the plan. Warnings first. Nothing is ever moved.
flags.none: No flags on the projects shown.

flag.inversion_other: Ranked below {{other}}, but starts {{count}} days earlier on {{team}}
flag.inversionNoTeam_one: Ranked below {{other}}, but starts {{count}} day earlier (no shared team)
flag.inversionNoTeam_other: Ranked below {{other}}, but starts {{count}} days earlier (no shared team)

stale: The roadmap changed in the meantime — the list was reloaded. Your last change was not saved; make it again if you still want it.
saveForbidden: You are not allowed to change the roadmap
saveInvalid: A project in the list no longer exists — the list was reloaded
